/article/detail/85.html.title: Cumark Tower
/article/detail/85.html.summary: One of Guangdong Province's first prefabricated construction demonstration projects and a Shenzhen engineering construction technology demonstration project — Shenzhen's first high-rise built with the assembled steel structure light-panel building system under the EPC model. Floor area 38,697 m², 17 floors above ground.
/article/detail/85.html.bodyHtml:
One of Guangdong Province's first prefabricated construction demonstration projects and a Shenzhen engineering construction technology demonstration project.

Cumark Tower is Shenzhen's first high-rise built with the assembled steel structure light-panel building system under the EPC contracting model, Shenzhen's first EPC prefabricated steel structure project, and Shenzhen's first three-star green building prefabricated steel structure project. It was a 2017 demonstration project of Guangming New District and a 2017 observation project of China Construction Seventh Engineering Division. The project is designed to the national three-star green building standard and applies the assembled steel structure light-panel building system jointly developed by our company with the China Academy of Building Research, Tsinghua University and Chongqing University.

The project is located in Guangming New District Technology Industrial Park, Shenzhen, with a site area of 7,654 m² and a total floor area of about 40,000 m² — 2 floors underground and 17 floors above ground, 69.9 m high. The above-ground part adopts an all-steel structure with about 2,200 tons of steel; the exterior and interior wall panels use autoclaved lightweight concrete (ALC) high-performance panels, the floor decks use steel-bar truss decks, and the curtain wall system adopts an insulating LOW-E energy-saving system.

Floor area: 38,697 m²

Building height: 76.4 m

Above ground: 17 floors

Below ground: 2 floors

/article/detail/294.html.title: Qiufu Prefabricated Heavy-Steel Villa
/article/detail/294.html.summary: Located in Meizhou, Guangdong Province, with heavy steel as the main frame and a composite wall of dry-hung ceramic panels + ALC wall panels as the cladding system. Seismic fortification intensity 9 degrees; withstands force-17 typhoons.
/article/detail/294.html.bodyHtml:
The project is located in Meizhou, Guangdong Province. Heavy steel serves as the main frame of the house, and a composite wall of dry-hung ceramic panels and ALC wall panels serves as the cladding system of the entire house.

With a seismic fortification intensity of 9 degrees, it can withstand force-17 typhoons, and it outperforms traditional brick-concrete structures in thermal insulation, heat insulation, sound insulation and environmental performance.
